_note: Consolidated segment data, Rs crore. BPCL reports two segments: downstream petroleum (refining and marketing of petroleum products, incl. gas, petchem, lubes, aviation) and exploration & production (BPRL). Segment EBITDA = segment result + segment depreciation & amortisation (segment results include exchange differences). Segment revenue is external revenue; excise (the gap between external revenue and Screener's net sales) is taken out of downstream, so downstream revenue = Screener net sales less E&P revenue. 'Unallocated' = Screener operating profit (EBITDA) less the sum of segment EBITDA: a small reconciliation difference (−41 to +473). BPCL does not split refining from marketing. Volumes: domestic market sales (MMT) from the July-2026 investor presentation (p33) and the Q1FY27 handout.
